reason: The provision establishes a general risk management system for high-risk AI systems, which is a relevant obligation for mitigating risks like prompt injection. However, it does not specifically address the technical mechanisms for mitigating these particular attack vectors.
evidence_excerpt: 1. A risk management system shall be established, implemented, documented and maintained in relation to high-risk AI systems. | (a) the identification and analysis of the known and the reasonably foreseeable risks that the high-risk AI system can pose to health, safety or fundamental rights when the high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose; | (b) the estimation and evaluation of the risks that may emerge when the high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose, and under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse; | (d) the adoption of appropriate and targeted risk management measures designed to address the risks identified pursuant to point (a).
